import hashlib, json, re
from pathlib import Path
from html import unescape
root = Path('products/services/catalogue-inbound-cad')
packet_path = root / 'operator-reply-packet.json'
rehearsal_path = root / 'decision-table-rehearsal.json'
live_path = Path('products/distribution/catalogue-referral/2026-11-19-direct-catalogue-readback.html')
def digest(path):
    return hashlib.sha256(path.read_bytes()).hexdigest()
packet = json.loads(packet_path.read_text())
rehearsal = json.loads(rehearsal_path.read_text())
live = unescape(re.sub(r'<[^>]*>', ' ', live_path.read_text())).lower()
replies = packet['replies']
branches = {name: text.strip().removeprefix('EN\n').split('\n\nFR\n') for name, text in replies.items()}
checks = {'source_hash_matches': packet['rehearsal_sha256'] == digest(rehearsal_path), 'five_fictional_checks_passed': len(rehearsal['checks']) == 5 and all(row['passed'] for row in rehearsal['checks']), 'exact_bilingual_branches': set(branches) == {'diagnostic', 'commission'} and all(replies[name].startswith('EN\n') and len(parts) == 2 and all(part.strip() for part in parts) for name, parts in branches.items()), 'live_capture_mentions_20_rows': bool(re.search(r'20\s+(?:rows|lignes)', live))}
checks['ai_disclosure_both_languages'] = all(len(parts) == 2 and 'autonomous ai' in parts[0].lower() and 'ia autonomes' in parts[1].lower() for parts in branches.values())
diagnostic = replies['diagnostic'].lower()
commission = replies['commission'].lower()
checks['diagnostic_scope_and_location'] = all(term in diagnostic for term in ('20 rows', '20 lignes', 'synthetic or anonymized', 'fictives ou anonymisées', 'attachments', 'pièces jointes', 'style', 'manual', 'manuel'))
checks['commission_operator_and_customer_confirmation_en'] = all(term in commission for term in ('operator', 'approve', 'acceptance criteria', 'price', 'your confirmation'))
checks['commission_no_payment_destination'] = not any(term in commission for term in ('@', 'https://', 'interac'))
result = {'sources': {str(path): digest(path) for path in (packet_path, rehearsal_path, live_path)}, 'checks': checks, 'all_pass': all(checks.values()), 'coverage': 'Offline checks of committed text and fictional routing. These checks do not establish operator approval of terms, customer delivery, acceptance, deposit or Treasury posting.'}
output = root / 'operator-packet-check.json'
output.write_text(json.dumps(result, indent=2) + '\n')
print(output.read_text())
